title: Dragon and Cloud Spirit
description: A black dragon with glowing yellow eyes perches on a flowering yellow tree atop a cliff, looking toward a smiling pink cloud spirit with braided hair floating nearby. A wooden sign reading "THE BEGINNING" stands in the foreground beside a river with a stone bridge, set against a mountain range under a twilight sky with crescent moons.
prompt: A black eastern dragon with glowing yellow eyes perched on a tree full of bright yellow blossoms on a cliff edge, facing a cute smiling pink cloud creature with a long braided ponytail floating in the air. Wooden sign in foreground says THE BEGINNING. River with stone arch bridge winds through the scene toward distant purple mountains under a dreamy twilight sky with multiple crescent moons and golden orbs, whimsical fantasy style, vibrant colors.
